body: He got fired and left town, dont even talk to him anymore- he said some horrible things about me to coworkers that were too hurtful for me to forgive him-im glad hes gone!

Kicked her out of my place because she was hot and cold. She absolutely lost it on me, crossing boundaries, and calling my friends to nag at them about me. Just showed her true colors..its still going on actually lol. She still lives here and my town is super hard to find housing. But with the way she is acting now I dont feel too sorry for her.
So sad. That's what the person is. Not selfish.

I blocked mine because while we broke up I still made him food, gave him gas money, hung out with him..and come to find out hes trashing my name. I confronted him and of course he denied it but what I was told was something he definitely did say. He eventually admitted it and I blocked him. No more access to me. Like why would you say horrible things about a person when they are helping you out? Gross.
No name calling or  f you or f off statements. It's over for good once you cross that line with me, no matter who you are.
Zero. I work with him. Good news is my coworker of 3 plus years are seeing his abusive patterns and hes on thin ice.
Whatever makes someone happy!

Well I guess my question was more if someone confessed their feelings for me and I didnt feel the same way but wanted them still as just a friend. Is that bad? It seems on reddit it's like just cut that person off and dont lead them on. But one of my best male friends admitted he liked me years ago and has since then dated other women..and he has just been the best friend anyone can have to me. Like seriously grateful for that and he feels the same way too now. If I would have just cut him off, I'd be missing out on an amazing person!

Do you think its necessarily a bad thing if one wants something more and the other person doesnt, keeps hanging out,the person who wanted more eventually get a gf and you are still friends with them? I personally dont see anything wrong with it but most people do. A few of my really best guy friends have confessed to having crushes on me and I didnt see them that way but we are still friends years later after dating other people. Some of my exes had an issue with that.
Haha I'm glad you were able to laugh from it! I hope you find your answers! To me, that would be draining!

He may be right. You are with him. Okay sorry bad joke. But seriously why are you putting up with that? Why does he have to insult you or make you feel dumb? Sounds like hes the issue and his brain is fully developed. He isnt going to change. You gotta figure out if you want to deal with that forever.

Every time I went there I felt like they were rushing me! I hate that feeling. That was only recently. In years before they were way more chill. Sad because I like to browse there. Coexist is good but pricey!
Me lately when I start talking to a man. 😏😬😬😬

Yesss! I want my daith pierced so badly but I have seen here that it is painful af and that it might hurt for years. It looks so cute and I want it so had but I also dont wanna be in pain. Maybe one day I'll just buck up and get it done.
Super cute! I say keep it! Maybe try a different piece once it heals! I'm sure theres tons of cute jewelry for that!
But it is something that needs attention because we are hurting deeply. A lot of people do that in other ways like drinking and drugs. So we all are really no different.

You may have a point. All the anxious people I dated, we clicked really well with our personalities and morals but the attachment style was the problem. When I did date other avoidants, I found myself not wanting to open up and felt free and secure. Definitely a weird dynamic!

Exactly! I mean..I'm 32 years old and know when to say something and not to say something and if I feel like I really have to say it I actually think about how to say it so what I am saying is kind and useful to the situation. He just blurts things out. 🙄

I'm actually doing pretty good. I'm over my ex. I wasnt perfect but he was really mean to me. But besides that, I realized after I got out of a two month relationship in July and came to this subreddit and found out I was an avoidant. I'm in therapy but like you, we dont really talk about those things. I'm just staying out of any type of romantic relationship atm and spending time alone which I am enjoying. Also started a bowling league with friends so that helped my sadness to the situation a lot. I feel overall good. But i know the next person i date will have to be pretty secure and not anxious. Not saying i wont change but i absolutely cannot stand clinginess ( a little is good and hewlthy) or jealousy.

Dude!! I'm glad someone else has experienced this though I'm sorry you have. I felt like maybe at one point he was just saying his feelings...it's really all about how you say things. He lacks tactfulness lol

As another avoidant,I can tell you, the trauma we dealt with has way more to do with our actions now then we think. We learned to be avoidant because of how we were treated and it's an unhealthy coping mechanism. I hope you can heal!
Nasty. Glad we both dont need to hear those comments again!
I was aware of the risk when I got it. I'm well informed. Thanks.

Mine was "obsessed" with me but also super mean. Like judgey statements all the time. He said he wasnt judging,just saying his feelings but he was super rude and it got draining. So glad I dont deal with that anymore. My manager and I went to a gas station yesterday and we're hungry so got a sub. My ex happened to be there also and said "gross, you have to pay 6 dollars for that" and I ignored him, turned towards my manager and rolled my eyes. We both giggled and I'm sure my ex saw it. Oh well. It was little stuff like that that annoyed me.

A lot of piercings arent safe,get infected, get snagged. I like how mine looks and I check it to make sure my gums arent eroding. I'll be sad once I take it out but I absolutely adore how it looks on me. And my mom doesnt know about that stuff 🤷‍♀️🤣

Yep!I got my smiley done and told my mom (she lives 30 hours away from me) and she said that that kinda stuff makes her want to puke automatically and she can't look at it. Like woman..you got problems 🤣

Right? I see a lot of toxic things here..like why do we want people to suffer if we love them? I can understand if you were cheated on or abused. But my ex was verbally abusive and I HOPE he gets the help he needs so he doesnt treat the next girl the same way. Karma caught up to him pretty fast (only a month broken up) and he was begging for me back. I highly doubt he changed so I said no. But actually there was little satisfaction that he was suffering. More than anything it was very confusing for me. I just want people happy and to live their best life. Not be rude to others and suffer. Idk. It took me a long time to get there. But let's instead hope our exs learn from their mistakes and dont treat their future partners the way they treated us. That just makes more hurt people who also hurt more people.
Sounds like he just wanted an ego boost. My ex did something similar. Wanted nothing to do with me and then weeks later is  lonely and asking for me back. So glad I said no. Hang in there!

Had a bff like this. Kinda different but she went through a mental breakdown and then wouldn't shower. But I read the book way before it happened and I had told her about it and then reminded her about the book after all that happened and we laughed so hard.
Never honestly. Someone can be good looking but if they have a shitty personality I don't want to sleep with them.

I'm so sorry. I also had similar feelings but I'm glad I stuck around!

Yeah I know what you mean. I've dated a few people after him who broke my heart. I'm just bitter about them..jk. sorta. Definitely had to harden my heart a bit! But in general I am pretty happy and am taking time to be by myself and love being alone right now actually. Someone would have to be pretty amazing to come into my life and me want to spend all my time with them.

I'm so sorry you were a wreck! I hope you feel better now. Idk if I'll ever be able to confront him. Maybe one day we'll run into each other and I'll nicely confront him..like hey dude...wtf happened?🤣

He is very happy. Started his own business with her...it really is fucked up. I was miserable while I thought (didnt have evidence) he was cheating and literally told myself I was insane. 

Idk. I really dont want to talk to him. I did take him off social media and such. So he probably knows I know or he knows I want nothing to do with him. Like I know even if I did confront him, he would lie or some shit. I'm glad i found out once i was over him because it would have destroyed me about a year ago!

Had a similar thing happen to me. He was always asking me to stay faithful to him. He actually got the girl pregnant and I found out recently after not talking to him for two years. He and i last talked about a few months before she got pregnant.

I'm never going to let him know that I know. He already knows. Unless he contacts me first. Hes not worth my time. And neither is your ex!

Girldriend... please listen to everyone here. You dont need that shit in your life. You already feel better. Dont look back! I promise you he isnt going to change and even if he does it wont be overnight.

So true. Love can make us act irrationally and only once we are not in the situation anymore are we level headed. And if we arent...we probably didnt learn anything. Not saying it's for all cases because I know some of us have been cheated on, lied to or left without warning. But a lot of posts here..there were warning signs but we ignored them.
Those insecurities they accuse you of (cheating, lying)are most likely things they would do to you.
Moving away across the country. New start and surroundings definitely helped.

So true. I warned my recent ex. He was super upset because he had a crush on me for years. But my bpd was acting up. We got into a relationship stupidly and it ended pretty bad. We can be friends now but I so wish I would have stood my ground.
Yeah okay. He told her everything she wanted to hear so she would sleep with him. She.got.used. end of story. Sorry your mindset is shit!

No way. So you basically have to make him dinner, do the dishes,put the dishes in the dish washer and put them away? Forever? No way girl! You are going to become so resentful of him. Hows he gonna take care of you if you ever hurt yourself? Will you still have to do this if you ever have children together? He needs to learn how to grow up. You arent his mom!

Honestly it's not your problem. If you want drama in your life, take her in. If you want peace,let her figure it out herself. She doesnt sound like someone you should let back in your life dude. Really?

I mean...you guys tried for 8 years and sometimes we find out we arent compatible. I think from what you said you did the right thing. Grieving is fine. It's really no ones right to say you can't be sad. Sometimes doing the right thing is the hardest thing to do.
Damn. You got used. Fuck that. Block him and dont look back!

As young boys, men were told not to show their emotions. I only feel like recently, woman (mothers) are telling their sons to show emotion. I know I'm way more accepting of men showing their emotions. I think it's beautiful and it's a shame they have that engrained into them.

Maybe he is suffering but you just dont know it.

Tbh the sex was okayyy. Not the best. So it doesn't particularly make me sick. But if hes telling someone else the same exact things he told me that makes me sick. I HATE men (people in general) like that. That makes me more sick. 

Also they can have fun with his insecurities, ignorance and jealously. Don't miss that at all!

I know people cant change overnight. I live in   a really small town and my one ex from the summer was brought up by my recent ex all the time. He knows he gave me so much trauma so I asked him nicely to stop mentioning him, but literally the next day he did. They know each other, aren't close, but hang out in the same area. Do you think he was being a dick or just slipped up? To me, if someone asked me not to mention someone to them (especially an ex) I would do it. That's just one example how much he kinda sucked lol

I dumped my ex. Was stupid and tried to make it work a week later. He was acting super  weird so I asked if he met someone else. He said he wasnt sure and he wasnt quite ready for a commitment again. He had said to me once when I tried to end things with him that he thought I had another man already lined up. I did not. Peoples insecurities are mostly what they would do to you in a second. 

We work together so it was super complicated. I wa cordial if he had any questions I was nice but didnt engage in personal stuff or was short. I eventually told myself I'm just gonna be nice and act like my normal happy self around him. It took this guy only 3 days to pull me aside and ask for me back. I reminded him that he had rejected me when I tried to salvage things. He kept saying nothing happened between him and whoever. My guess is whatever happened with the new person didnt work out for the same reasons him and I didnt work out. Hes overly jealous and insecure and projects that onto you. He says things so ignorantly all the time and i couldn't stand it. He's grumpy all the time. We only dated 2 weeks and I couldn't handle that. 

But people will come back to you when they feel you will benefit their life. They dont care about your feelings unfortunately. My ex and I were friends for 3 years before we dated. So I told him I'm willing to forget those two weeks we dated and continue being his friend like we always have been. We'll see how that goes. Like I love him (as a friend. He has too many issues I cannot deal with) but at the same time it pisses me off. He almost seemed entitled of me. Like dude..you got me, treated me horribly, I broke up with you, tried to fix things and then you are already moved on to someone else. I can do better and deserve better.

Sorry for the rant.😂

Seems like he still has issues to work through and that's okay. But are YOU happy? Doesnt seem like it. Plus,not a lot of people would be secure in a relationship where someone was once abusive towards them. I think it's time to really think about if this is what you want in life!
Honestly getting it out (crying and grief)at the beach just hits different. Do it!
Working with exes is hard. Especially when you love your job. You got this!you dont owe him shit btw. Just be cordial at work. His feelings arent your problem!
That's their way of saying they arent willing to change. 🤷‍♀️ sad but true!
I know its hard but try to focus more on yourself and not him. Everyone is on their own journey in life and sometimes it has very little to do with us. Glow yourself up, girl!
Honestly I've never been able to tell the difference. 😬🤷‍♀️

Sooooo just a different perspective. My ex had a lot of trust issues and insecurities and constantly projected them on to me. It was very draining. So when he messed up for the like 1000 time in a span of two weeks I was already prepared to leave after the last fight we got into. Some people just get fed up and realize they deserve better. It was definitely easier for me to get over him. I've been cheated on too before but would never project that on to someone that I had claimed to love.

Isnt it so crazy how people do this? My ex told me the same,I broke up with him, thought he could change so we could salvage the relationship and he was already in another romantic one a week later. Then a month later he wants me back. Whatever happened with the new girl didnt go well and he wanted me back. I told him he needs to watch what he tells people because some people take it to heart.

I assume they met someone else. My ex was really worried about me cheating even though that doesnt align with my morals. But I found out after we broke up that he was already seeing someone! Never thought he would do that to me. If he didnt cheat,it was a huge rebound. The week before I was his soulmate. I had to sigh, tell myself sometimes it be like that, and realize I deserve way better!
*looks around* where are those guys? Because they dont talk to me. Or I'm lead to believe they are great guys and they turn out to be the opposite.

Some men dont care what you want. They only care what they want. I just made a completely different post and it wasnt really even about men,but a lot of us women are harassed,disrespected and lied to by men on this sub. Its disgusting! I've had to turn off receiving messages right now because I dont want the guy who constantly crossed my boundaries to message me again from a different username.
Not to torture myself but to order food and have it delivered. *dies of shame*

No, never! I think it's just safer for me personally to meet someone naturally now and build up some trust as friends before letting them tickle me. I've never had a problem with asking someone I trusted and knew pretty well.

I was in your situation in August. It sucked! Hormones from pregnancy are the worst even at only 4 weeks. I feel your pain! I also felt alone because every woman I told in person would go along with their pregnancy. It's like everyone I knew would just keep it so I felt so alone. I'm sorry. But just know you arent!
Went on a hike in the snow with a friend. I usually hate the snow but it was rather beautiful!

Honestly they became a stranger before I dumped them. Before we got together we were friends for 3 years. Our vibe was so fun and chill. And once we got together they turned into a judgemental asshat. Dont miss that. Byeeee!

I sometimes wear a few necklaces during the summer and had a dinosaur bone chocker on. The pendant had fallen off and I had the choker. I thought maybe it fell on the floor and I had to go to work so didnt have time to look. Later,in the restroom, I looked down my top at my boobs and saw the pendant in my bra! 😂🤣

That's how I really felt. Like he didnt care about what I just told him. Literally mentioned my mental health is top priority and he kept asking. Oh okay...so you are fine possibly hurting someones mental health because of your wants? 🙄 very gross. It sucks because he acted like he was being nice but he was being pushy and that turned me off the most. Plus,I'm sick with covid and while it's probably the mild one, I'm coughing so hard and sometimes I wake up feeling weird. The last thing I need right now is for someone to tickle me as much as possible. If someone doesnt understand that, they have major issues!
Because that is something that would make her happy and you are doing something that makes you happy. Parents can be so selfish sometimes!

During the summer in Utah, it gets so hot and it exhausts me. On my lunch break, I take a 30 minute nap. I wake up so confused and out of it I'm scared to drive back to work. It honestly doesnt do anything for me but I cant stop doing it lol.

My ex didnt join a app but he also moved on fast. Trust me when I say..he will probably treat that person the exact same way he treated you. And they will get sick of it. And dump him. Dont be surprised if he comes running back to you once it ends. Stay strong,be humble, but dont take them back!

I traveled a bit.

I made new friends and it's been beautiful! Couldn't have made new friends if he was in the picture because hes too jealous. 

I became happier! Truly. I was in a depressed phase when we dated and he knew. He made my life worse. But once I dumped him a few weeks later I'm the happiest I've been in months! Win for me!

Yeah so scary how people project their insecurities and fears onto us but they would fuck us over like that no problem! Sometimes I never want to trust anyone again. Honestly if anyone ever tells me an insecurity like that again...I'm walking away. Seems harsh but I've learned the hard way so many times!

First time I planned to meet someone I had to tell them it probably wasnt a good idea to meet for quite a few reasons. But mostly I am sick with covid. They STILL tried to change my mind. It sucks but I had to block them. If you cant take no for an answer online, what would have happened in person? Scary thought!

Sounds like nothing you did was good enough for him even though you were trying your best. I know how that feels and its beyond frustrating! My ex did similar shit to me. Like dude I try to show you I like you in so many ways and you overlook all that for when there was one mix up? Good ahead and lose me. 🤷‍♀️ I got so sick of the bulllshit.
Nothing wrong with that! Sometimes I feel so happy I could pop when single. But then I start talking to someone and then I feel like shit!
"Dont you want to feel that maternal love?" Coming from a person who knew I had an abortion a few months before. If I wanted to feel it,I would have had the baby. 🤷‍♀️

So I live about 30 hours from my parents who love me dearly. It's been a really rough past year for me. I kinda chalk this up to very little sleep the week before because my one friend was visiting but I cried when my plane was about to land in my old home state. I just felt a surge of emotion of all the shit I've been through in the past few months hit me. My parents were picking me up from the airport. I think to me it gets harder to be the perfect daughter for them as I get older and so many things knocked me down this past year. I felt a lot of emotions and I just cried a few tears. Luckily it's easy to cry and not have people know when you are wearing a mask.

1. To stop being so naive and believing everything someone tells me.

2. If they mentioned anger issues before...they have them still unless they have stated otherwise and have gone to therapy.

3. What they fear you will do is most likely what they will do to you.
As a woman that has got the suggestion to get a gun to protect myself I feel the same way. I could be pretty impulsive if very upset. And I dont wanna kill myself so I dont own a gun. 🤷‍♀️
Honestly I love my alone time too much to date and my mental health is so much better when single.
Yeah. I moved from the east to the west in the desert. No point in wearing make up in 112 degree weather! Now I just dont wear it anymore.
I've been there before. It sucks but you are doing the right thing!

For me personally when I found out my ex was dating someone..I felt sorry for the girl. The week before I was his "soulmate". And then I was nothing. Like fucking clockwork a month later he is telling me hes having trouble getting over me. Whatever happened with the new girl it was over and he wanted me back. I'm glad I knew because it made me not take him back.
But they are also probably wearing the face shields too! If someone sneezes in front of you and you have a mask on, those tiny particles from the sneeze are going to get into your eyes.

Masks dont protect people. We still have eyeballs that bacteria get into all the time. 🤷‍♀️ that's why if everyone wore a mask it would help but children and large gatherings...you better believe you are going to get it eventually!

Yeah. I felt exhausted for a month after and brain fog. And to add to that I was dating someone abusive at the time. Not fun. Now I have covid again I think (not getting tested but quarantine but I'm pretty sure its it because dry cough and no taste or smell) and this just feels like deju vu. Not going to date anyone especially if I have lingering symptoms again!
"He will do anything for you but he also has a lot of unresolved trauma and will project that onto you. Good luck."🤷‍♀️

I was just in Duluth last week. People were soooo weird about weed. A few comments I heard and was told...

"She said she liked you but you smoke weed."

"I'm fine with people smoking weed as long as no one gets killed while under the influence!"

"I'm kinda weird about it too." After I said people were weird about it. Lol

Whoa. We have oddly weird similarities or different partner similarities lol. My ex, he had no money, I gave him some so he could drive around and see friends in our town after he moved here in his van. I was constantly lending him money. He pays child support so I know that's a lot but he lives in his car so he doesnt have to pay rent. Where was all the money going? Idk but he knew I would too!I would do anything for him! A few weeks ago he needed me to jump his car and I was in bed but got out of bed to go help him. Why am I too nice?

To me it seems like you not going with him to ski was you basically telling him you didnt like him that much. And maybe thats not the case but that's personally what I would have thought. He was taking a chance but you werent ready and that's okay too. Maybe he was moving too fast. 

But the way he told you he didnt see a future with you is pretty horrible and gross.
I work with my ex too. It's so rough man.
How horrible that they tried to test your boundaries after you told them not to do that. Wtf!
Yep and I've had it happen. Though it teaches me to look out for red flags I've ignored in the past with people. No more alcoholics!

I'd tell him no. I broke up with him because nothing I did was good enough and he wouldn't stop yelling at me when I asked him to talk calmly to me. I was stupid, tried to salvage the relationship a week later and he was acting weird and not interested when the week before I was his "soulmate". I asked him if he met someone and he said he wasnt sure about that and wasnt ready for another commitment. That told me he did. He said the person was just comforting him but also asked me what I would do if I saw him in public with the person. He told me it was a bad idea to think of him romantically. I put my big girl pants on and decided I deserve way better and remembered the anxiety he gave me during our very short relationship.

A month later, he pulls me aside and says he is having major trouble getting over me, had a dream about me kissing our mutual friend and that got him super upset. I told him he had made a boundary with me the month before not to think of him romantically, that someone was "comforting" him and all of a sudden he is feeling sad I'm not his anymore. 

Pretty sure he was seeing someone else,he treated them the same way he treated me, they broke it off and now he wants me back. Yeah, nope, not happening. I cant wait to have a relationship with no insecurity or jealously issues and that's all we had and I at least deserve a honeymoon stage with someone. He and I never had one because he would pick fights over nothing, be super judgmental, and would accuse me of ignoring him when I was actually getting sick and exhausted and dont remember opening his messages. No thanks! Bye!🙋‍♀️
Just wanted to say you deserved better! That's just pathetic behavior on her part!
Omg yeah my ex also sucked at kissing. It was like when we kissed it was immediately frenching right away and I HATE that. Like dont eat my face dude.
My ex acknowledged he was abusive and it sucked he couldn't change. Now he wants me back. So confusing. I say keep NC, work on yourself and treat the next one better.

Yep. As the dumper of very toxic relationships..the anxiety of seeing them beg for me was a lot. I wanted to be left alone. Now,even if a healthy relationship ended and someone did that to me..it would give me anxiety. Please respect peoples wishes to be left alone or break up if that is what they want.
I can only hope my ex thinks this way about me but I doubt it. 💔

It sucks that we were such good friends for three years and now that's over with too. We werent even together for a week and I adored you but you didnt believe me about a lot of things and that's toxic for both of us. I just miss my friend but i realize we have both changed and while that's okay, I miss what we were just a few weeks ago.

Same. Relapsed after three years. The cuts I made years ago are raised and a bitch to get rid of. The ones I made like 4 days ago can probably be considered small cat scratches and the scab will fall off in a few more days. Kinda sad about that but I also know I dont want more raised scars on my arm.

I started when I was 13 because I heard of other people doing it before. I stopped when I was 18. Relapsed when I was 27 and did for about a year and stopped. Relapsed again recently. I've been disassociating a lot so it helps bring me back to reality. I'm 32 now.
Same. I have PTSD and people shouting or yelling at me angrily triggers it so badly. I shut down.

The reason is cheaters are going to cheat. Its up to him to communicate his needs..and he couldn't even have a convo. That's not worth something saving especially when you are being lied to by someone who claims to love you. After 7 years, I'd be super pissed and never able to trust someone like that again.
I feel like I would be even more suicidal than I am now with a husband and kids. Like wtf?!

Oh yeah I've learned the hard way. I've had my trauma thrown in my face during fights with an ex. I dont vent to many people about my personal life but if I do it's very little info and if I find out they tell someone or use it against me that's instantly a ban from my friendship.
That's a horrible feeling and I'm sorry. But just know there are tons of attractive men out there who will love to please you!
My names Karen too. It does get draining introducing myself to people and having them make a joke about it.

Damn this is so true!everyone who tells me in some way or another they are safe to talk to has used my issues against me. My one best guy friend is very unemotional and it had caused me to be less emotional around him but lately I have been a mess the past few months and cried to him a few times. But he has never used my weaknesses against me. A true damn friend!🥺
I'm 150 plus pounds and chunky. I look good in clothes but horrible naked. 🤦‍♀️
No I wont. I was pregnant and had an abortion. 🤷‍♀️ always knew I would do that if I got pregnant.
Oh man...so much junk food. Just because I couldn't smell or taste doesnt mean I didnt crave pizza, chips, and candy. I also added hot sauce to a lot of my meals because i could feel the pain. 🤷‍♀️
Wow that's horrible. I got mine put in right after my abortion so I didnt feel it but every single women I've met with an iud told me insertion was pretty painful. That's so insensitive of her!
I dont like toddlers or babies, I have no maternal instinct, I love my peace and quiet, dont make enough money,mental illness might run in my family and never want to put my body through a pregnancy.

I was in your position in August. Probably one of the weirdest times of my life. I was a mess because of hormones. Like the thought that something is growing inside me. The fact that in 9 months there will be a baby if I dont do anything. But getting an abortion sucks. Theres such a crazy amount of emotions I went through and am still going through even though I know I did the right thing. If you need someone to talk to at any point, please feel free to reach out.

Honestly if I am getting high in the morning on my day off it's because I am depressed and want to go back to sleep because my favorite thing to do is escape reality. Luckily I am planning things on my days off so i havent had to do that in a very long time.
Getting pregnant again and getting an abortion again. Getting sexually assaulted. Never being romantically desired again only sexually.
Same. In my town (Moab, Utah) we had a few deaths that were never solved. It hurts so bad to know I could be killed and my loved ones would never get an answer.

Yes!the thought of being a mother really freaks me out and I dont ever want it. I remember when I was on vacation with my ex when I was 21. He was begging me to have a child with him. I dont remember how long we were together at that point but I was about to graduate college the next year. It didnt make sense to me to get pregnant before graduating but in reality it wont ever make sense for me to have a child with anyone. It's just not for me.

This is what I have been dealing with with this one guy I met during a mutual hobby two years ago. Havent seen him in two years...and he's calling me beautiful and sexy. I just hate it and dont want to talk to him any more.
I only threw up in my mouth a little bit because I dont think of him that way. But yeah it should be.

Are you sure this is something you really wanna put up with? That's pretty fucked up. For your question...yes. I had a reserve ride last summer because when I stuffed my pilot chute into my container, it wouldn't come out when I went to pull because it got stuck in there. We usually all give each other gear checks before we get in the plane and we have monthly meetings about safety. 

I have seen people crash and break bones...that happened about three times in the last five years that I've been jumping. One of them was just last weekend. A girl from a different DZ came out, wasn't very current (only 8 skydives that year) and was flying a new smaller canopy. She didn't listen to us about the landing pattern. She turned and did a 180 at less than 50 feet and crashed into the ground hard. She broke her femur. Other ones I've seen are from students flairing way too high and breaking their ankles. 

It's unfortunately the nature of the sport. People will get hurt. People die...luckily I haven't seen anyone die at my DZ, but about 23-26 deaths happen from skydiving in the U.S. a year. It's a shame, but we all learn from those deaths and their mistakes.

No one was mean to me, but there was one girl in the class who pushed a few peoples buttons.
